preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the move-up restriction k satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p_i < i for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=2))
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 parent indices p_2, ..., p_n, where each p_i is a valid parent vertex (1 ≤ p_i < i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Vertices are labeled from 1 to n, inclusive.
The input defines a valid tree rooted at vertex 1, where p is the parent list (p[0] is unused).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of distinct leaves that can be visited in a valid move sequence.
The output equals the maximum number of distinct leaves that can be visited in any valid sequence of moves, where max_possible_leaves(n, k, p) is the correct result for the given tree and k.
